title: ack
description: Receiver to server: result of applying a command or correction. Server to origin: forwarded with from and attempt. (both directions)

ok.description: true when the read-back (and effect, where defined) matches.

superseded.description: Not written because a newer command for the same var is already known (seq order).

from.description: Set by the server when forwarding.

reason.description: ok false only. press_lost: a mirrored press could not be applied (the button was already down with no local press): red. not_synced: the var behaves like a press counter and is not synced (an amber line covers it): no red. display_check: an encoder click whose proof is its display, compared 2 s after the last click: no red per click.
